description: 2016 MAML Horse River wildfire hourly data is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Parks. Hourly data collected by Alberta Environment and Parks using a mobile atmospheric monitoring laboratory (MAML) as part of emergency response monitoring during the 2016 Horse River Wildfire. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Parks. Its tags are Fort McMurray, Horse River wildfire, NO2, SO2, air quality. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
